name: conversation-lifeboat
description: Detect overloaded Codex conversations and hand work off to a fresh task through a durable project specification.

interface.shortDescription: Move overloaded Codex conversations into clean tasks.
interface.longDescription: Monitors transcript and context pressure, warns before the conversation becomes unusable, and provides a confirmation-gated workflow that writes a durable handoff specification before continuing in a fresh task.
defaultPrompt: Assess this task and prepare a safe handoff if it is overloaded.
Preserve this conversation in a spec and continue in a fresh task.
